{
  "name": "worktree-terminal",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Open a terminal in the session's worktree or any agent's worktree: /term, or the buttons above the prompt",
  "author": {
    "name": "Bruno Carneiro",
    "url": "https://github.com/brunolca"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/brunolca/claude-plugins/tree/main/plugins/worktree-terminal",
  "repository": "https://github.com/brunolca/claude-plugins",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "terminal",
    "worktree",
    "agents",
    "kitty",
    "tmux",
    "wezterm",
    "iterm"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "terminal": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Terminal app",
      "description": "Which terminal /term opens; auto detects it from the window Claude runs in",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "tmux",
        "zellij",
        "kitty",
        "wezterm",
        "iterm",
        "ghostty",
        "warp",
        "alacritty",
        "gnome-terminal",
        "konsole",
        "terminal",
        "system",
        "custom"
      ]
    },
    "placement": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Placement",
      "description": "split (right of Claude), tab or window; falls back to what the terminal supports",
      "default": "split",
      "options": [
        "split",
        "tab",
        "window"
      ]
    },
    "customCommand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom command",
      "description": "Used when Terminal app is custom: argv split on spaces, {dir} replaced by the worktree path",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
